$description: Tokens this project adds to the FX Replay kit. Every entry aliases a value the kit already has: none introduces a color. The reason for each, with the contrast before and after, is in docs/brand-notes.md.

border-field.$description: Boundary of a form field. The kit's border tokens reach 1.81:1 at most on the ground, and a control's boundary needs 3:1. dark-200 is the value the kit's own outline button uses.

border-field-error.$description: Boundary of a form field in error. The kit's border-error (error-dark) is 2.46:1 on the ground. Always paired with an icon and a message, never color alone.

border-focus.$description: Focus ring: 2px with a 2px offset, so it sits on the ground. One step lighter than the kit page's Electric Blue ring, to stay distinct from the primary button it surrounds.

text-link.$description: Links and small brand-colored text on the dark ground. The kit's text-brand (blue-600) is 4.02:1 there, short of the 4.5:1 that body-size text needs.

card-text-link.$description: Links inside bg-tertiary surfaces, where blue-500 drops to 4.44:1.

btn-border-primary.$description: Edge of the primary button while hovered or pressed. The kit's hover and pressed fills (blue-800, blue-900) are 1.70:1 and 1.31:1 against the ground, so the button would lose its shape. blue-500 is 5.26:1 against the ground and 3.10:1 against the hover fill.

chart-up.$description: Rising candles in the replay illustration: Electric Blue. Decorative, carries no text.

chart-down.$description: Falling candles in the replay illustration. Blue and near-white instead of green and red, so the picture reads as the brand and does not color a trade as good or bad.

chart-grid.$description: Grid lines of the replay illustration: the value of the kit's border-primary.

chart-future.$description: Hatching over the part of the illustration that has not been replayed yet.

chart-playhead.$description: The playhead of the replay illustration. 5.26:1 against the ground, so the line is visible as a graphic object.
